scope: Phase D consolidation provider purpose + runJob/candidate persistence (not wired to Host profile; no publish/versions/UI)
behavior: provider allowlist now has separate historical PURPOSES (3) and MODEL_PURPOSES including memory_consolidate; old queue still rejects consolidation purpose
harness-provider has a fixed memory_consolidate prompt and prompt+input length accounting; no tools/network/paths
runJob requires a controlled provider and trusted synchronous authorizeExecution; no authorization = MC_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE before dispatch
runJob rechecks manifest/permission before dispatch and after model output; validates mc-output-v1 against InputSnapshot
valid output persists candidate body (content), candidate entry/root sources/dependencies (authority), moves job ready and clears input; store.revision is not advanced
invalid model output becomes stale and writes no candidate; input is cleared
candidate ID is deterministic mc-candidate:<jobId>; foreign/terminal run tokens cannot overwrite
limitations: No publish/version head/CAS/search/version retrieval, no candidate UI or management API; candidate is storage-only.
No Host scheduler/profile dispatch broker/budget reservation wiring; runJob is exercised with a synthetic provider and a temporary store.
No real model/Provider call; no real profile queue. Excerpt mode remains unsupported.
No automatic idle dispatch; the idle gate does not yet call this queue.
No cross-restart provider-unknown reconciliation beyond job state/input clearing; publish path is still required.
